resources.string: This screen lost its link to the host, for example after the host was restarted. Open it again from the NukeApp-OSS entry in the host\'s settings.
Saved options apply after the host restarts.
Saved; turns on after the host restarts
Saved; turns off after the host restarts
Blocks the like action on double tap in the feed.
A double tap opens the comment panel for the current video.
Pauses the current video when it finishes instead of looping it.
Stops playback from resuming on its own when the player is rebuilt, for example after returning to the app.
Hides the follow button under the creator\'s avatar in the feed.
Stops Douyin from checking for a new version while idle.
Stops the player from switching to the data-saving low-quality mode.
Returning to the home feed no longer refreshes the videos.
Stops the feed from skipping a video that is no longer public while you watch it.
Tells the background and listen-mode check that there is no copyright restriction.
Removes ad entries from short drama episode lists.
Goes straight to the main screen when the splash ad screen opens.
Does not record your visit when you open another user\'s profile.
Lets you pick far more than 30 messages when forwarding.
Skip the mini game anti-addiction check
Answers the mini game anti-addiction check as passed, in the main process and in mini-game processes.
Does not send which conversations you have read, for every chat or for a blacklist or whitelist of chats.
All chats: no chat\'s read status is sent. Blacklist: only the chats below keep their read status to themselves. Whitelist: read status is sent only for the chats below.
Pick the friends and group chats the blacklist or whitelist applies to. Not used for All chats.
Does not send the typing indicator while you write.
Removes the quick-send emoji row at the bottom of a chat.
Shows emoji the chat panel normally hides.
Remove the friend row on messages
Removes the friend strip above the conversation list.
Stops full-screen effects triggered by certain words in a chat.
Stops view-once messages from being retired after you open them.
Removes the \"@author:\" prefix when you copy someone else\'s comment.
Allow QR scan from the album
Removes the rejection of QR codes read from an album image.
Opens third-party links without the security interstitial.
Stops the related-video list that opens when you tap a video\'s description.
Recalled messages stay readable, including ones you recall yourself unless you turn that off. Kept messages can be marked in the chat.
Removes the chosen tabs from the bottom bar. Only tick tabs your app actually shows.
Removes the chosen tabs from the strip above the feed. Only tick tabs your app actually shows.
Starts every video at the speed you choose.
Sets how many videos the offline cache keeps.
Adds your words to Douyin\'s danmaku block list, past its own limit.
Forces the density Douyin runs at. Very low values break the layout.
At least one tab always stays.
Applied when a video starts. Host default keeps Douyin\'s own speed.
One word per line. Added to the host\'s own list.
0 keeps the host density. Values from 1 to 169 are rejected.
Removes videos from the feed by type, counts, words and age. The feed always keeps at least one video.
Removes ad videos and marketing cards.
Removes videos marked as AI generated.
Removes live stream cards from the feed.
Removes videos of the two basic types (0 and 4). Only useful to keep other content in the feed.
Removes picture posts. Text and note posts are kept.
Removes live photos. Text and note posts are kept.
Removes videos that come from Xigua.
Removes videos with fewer. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with more. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with fewer. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with more. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with fewer. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with more. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with fewer. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with more. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with fewer. 0 turns the rule off.
Removes videos with more. 0 turns the rule off.
One word per line. A video is removed when its title contains any of them.
One word per line. A video is removed when its title lacks any of them.
Removes the chosen tabs from your own profile page. Only tick tabs you actually have.
Only tick tabs your profile has.
Removes the rings around avatars in the feed.
Hides the ring around friends\' avatars.
Hides the ring that shows a creator is live.
Removes groups and items from the panel that opens when you long-press a video. Do not hide everything.
Hides a whole group of the panel.
Hides single items inside the groups.
Keeps the progress bar visible on short videos too.
Shows exact numbers instead of rounded ones such as 1.2w.
Exact numbers for likes, comments, favorites, shares and followers.
Exact viewer count in live rooms, also where Douyin hides it.
Changes how full-screen portrait videos are sized in the feed.
Fit keeps wide videos from being cropped; fill stretches tall videos to the whole screen.
Removes the bottom bar background so the video shows behind it.
Removes the chosen actions from the share panel.
Actions removed from the share panel of a video.
Copies only the link when a video is shared as a link, without Douyin\'s text around it.
Turns Douyin\'s own autoplay on every time it starts.
Chooses which bitrate feed videos play.
0 applies the quality to every video.
0 applies the quality whatever the file size.
Stops Douyin from loading the listed hot-update plugins.
One plugin package per line. Each plugin Douyin loads is written to the module log the first time.
Hides the status bar when a video plays.
Shows the status bar again when playback pauses.
Warns when you move to a long video.
Videos at least this long are announced.
Closes Douyin after a stretch without use.
The module scheme closes Douyin when it is not touched for this long; Douyin\'s scheme starts its own sleep timer.
Heads up: this video is %1$s long.
Douyin\'s scheme keeps Douyin\'s own autoplay on; the module scheme moves on to the next video itself.
Module scheme: moves on after this long in a live room. 0 stays.
Module scheme: moves on after this long on an image post. 0 stays.
Shows the played and total time under the progress bar.
Offers forward on every chat message, such as voice messages.
Skips the ad chapters inside long videos.
Asks before the chosen taps do their work.
Taps that show a confirmation first.
Opening a friend\'s daily from the avatar
Entering a live room from the avatar
Tapping a topic in the description
Entering a live room from its cover
Makes the navigation bar transparent so the video shows behind it.
Shows the time and place of a video under its description: a line of your own with the publish time, IP location, length and position, and/or the host\'s own time and location label.
Adds a line under the description built from the template below.
Show the host\'s time and location label

Reveals the publish time and IP location label that the host hides in some places. Only used while the added line is off: with the line on, it shows the time, the location, the length and the position in one place and this label is left as the host has it. Takes effect after switching video.
A Java date pattern such as yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
Dresses your own messages in the bubble with the ID you enter.
Digits only. Leave empty to change nothing.
Shows another streak day count on the chat list. Only you see it.
One line per chat: conversationId=days. Use *=days for every chat.
Stay on the first profile tab
Opens a profile on its own first tab instead of jumping to another one.
Opens the red packets that arrive in your chats.
How long to wait before opening a packet.
Blacklist opens packets in every chat except the ones on the blacklist. Whitelist opens them only in the chats on the whitelist.
Blacklist: all chats but the listed
Friends and group chats whose red packets are not opened. Used in blacklist mode.
The only friends and group chats whose red packets are opened. Used in whitelist mode; an empty whitelist opens nothing.
One word per line. Packets whose pass phrase has one of them are not opened.
Sends one message a day to the chosen friends to keep your streaks going.
Pick the friends who get the daily message.
Sent in text mode, and in sentence mode when the sentence cannot be fetched.
An HTTP or HTTPS address that answers with plain text.
The daily send time, in this phone\'s time zone. Sent while Douyin is running.

Tied to the current account and runs only while the Douyin main process is alive. After saving, restart Douyin; sending starts at the next set time. A missed send is caught up the same day, never for earlier days. Each friend gets at most one try a day, and a failed or unknown send is not retried. Whether the streak continues depends on both sides and on Douyin\'s rules.
The feature is off. Turn its switch on after saving.
Not signed in to Douyin. The streak runs only for a signed-in account.
Sends Douyin\'s own streak interactive emoji; no emoji code or ID is needed. If its resources are not ready yet, open the chat\'s interactive emoji panel once.
Any HTTP or HTTPS address works; the response body is sent as is. It is fetched once a day and reused, and the backup text above is sent when the fetch fails.
Could not read the send history: %1$s
The backup text was sent (the sentence could not be fetched).
The sentence API address must start with http:// or https://.
Adds the publish time and the counts to video covers in the profile grid.
The lines added under the like count.
Removes the like count Douyin shows on the cover.
Hides the controls over the video while it plays and brings them back when it pauses.
Makes them transparent instead of removing them.
Makes the bottom, top and right controls of the feed more transparent.
Takes the chosen controls off the video screen.
Hidden again after each video change.
Hide the quick share button under the video
Marks the author as followed on your screen only.
Keeps chosen components, such as the like button, off the video screen.
One name per line. Each component name Douyin uses is written to the module log the first time it is seen.
Press and hold at the left or right edge of a video, then slide up or down to change its playback speed. Rest on a speed for a second to keep it.
Off: slow at the top and fast at the bottom.
Speed %1$sx kept. Long-press again to adjust.
Add a \"not interested\" button to the right side of a video. It runs the feed\'s own dislike action.
Where the button goes in the right-hand column.
Mark this video as not interested?
Could not run the dislike action.
Show the exact send time under every chat message.
A Java date-time pattern. Blank uses yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.
Swipe a chat message to the left to reply to it, the way the long-press menu\'s reply does.

Long-press the Messages tab in the bottom bar to open a menu with \"Mark all as read\". The menu also claims earned sparks and pet closeness for friends with a streak. A normal tap still opens the message page.
Could not mark all as read.
Claiming sparks from friends with a streak…
Claiming pet closeness from friends with a streak…
Sparks: checked %1$d chats, claimed %2$d, already claimed %3$d, failed %4$d, unknown %5$d, unavailable %6$d.%7$s
Closeness: checked %1$d chats, claimed %2$d, already claimed %3$d, failed %4$d, unknown %5$d, unavailable %6$d.%7$s
No friends with a streak to check.
Add buttons at the top of an author\'s page to copy their UID or their details.
The author\'s information could not be read
Hide comments that contain any of the words you list before they reach the comment panel.
Add a gender mark after the location label beside each comment.
Do not open the comment keyboard by itself on a video that has no comments.
Hide the like or the dislike button under each comment.
Makes the comment list transparent so the video shows through, can recolor its text and can show an image of your choice behind it. Restart Douyin to apply.

Records the comments you publish and checks whether others can see them, using the public web comment list and Douyin\'s own web login. My comments in the share panel lists them; with auto-check on, each new comment is checked once after a delay. Comments outside public comment lists cannot be checked.
Shows the exact time of each comment instead of \"3 minutes ago\" in the new comment panel. Douyin\'s shared time formatter is changed, so other places using it show exact times too.
Pauses the video when the comment panel opens and plays it again when the panel closes. A video you paused yourself stays paused.

Adds Comment details to a comment\'s long-press menu: author, time, likes, replies, region, status and IDs, with a button to copy the text. With bookmarks on, comments can also be bookmarked and opened again from the share panel.

When you send a voice comment, asks whether to replace the recording with an audio file you choose (MP3, WAV, FLAC, OGG, M4A, MP4 or SILK), converted to M4A. Conversion needs an arm64 device and does not work in Zygisk mode.
Add this post to your favourites?
Remove entries from the menu that opens when a comment is long-pressed.
One tag per line. Tags are written to the module log the first time they appear.
Remove the related-search strip from the comment panel.
Hide tabs of the comment panel by page type.
One number per line. Numbers are written to the module log the first time each page is asked about.
Add \"More\" to a danmaku\'s menu to see its details and copy the sender\'s ID.
Draws danmaku in random light colors, white one time in four. Restart Douyin to apply.
Add a "+1" box beside each chat bubble. Tapping it sends a copy of that message into the same chat.
Mark up the comments you publish as a hashtag, a mention of yourself or a location, so other people see them in blue. Other people see the change.
The mention style adds an @ at the end of the comment.
When you send a dice or rock-paper-scissors message, pick its result. The other person sees it as a normal random result.
Closes the guide that asks for notification permission and the separate system request, without changing any permission. Requests that also ask for other permissions are left alone.
Turns on the host\'s download action by lifting the local download permission checks.
Uses the playback source address when a video is downloaded.
Download image sets and live photos without watermark
Uses the original addresses of image sets, converts VVIC images and removes the local watermark of live photo videos.
Uses the original address when a comment image is saved.
Adds a save entry to the long-press menu of voice comments. The original audio goes to Music/douyin/audio.
Adds a save-to-gallery entry to sticker comments. The real format is detected and video stickers become GIFs.
Lift the Listen to Douyin filter
Skips the local content filter of Listen to Douyin. Whether a video is available there is still the host\'s decision.
Copies comments, profile signatures and video captions on a long press. Pick which ones below.
Adds a random gradient to the IP location shown under the caption, fixed per post for this run. Turn on Show time and location too.
Long-press the image in an avatar preview to save it to Pictures/douyin/avatar.
Storage permission is needed. Allow it and try again.
Save this avatar to your gallery?
Ticks the original-image option when the chat album or the e-commerce picker opens. You can still untick it. Takes effect the next time the picker opens.

Stops the code patch loader (Reparo) from initializing and from checking for patches, in every Douyin process. Patches already applied are not undone, and Gecko pages, plugins and server settings are not blocked. After switching it, force-stop Douyin and open it again.
Hides the teen mode prompt dialog. Takes effect after Douyin restarts.
Skip the mini app real-name prompt

Closes the unverified-user prompt that a mini app\'s API raises when it has a close button, through the host\'s own cancel path. A forced verification can still stop you. After switching it, force-stop Douyin and open it again.

Skips the reward video after \"watch an ad for a reward\" in mini apps and mini games and tells the app it loaded and closed. Only reward videos are handled; the app settles the reward itself, and a reward the server checks is not guaranteed. Takes effect after you reopen the mini app.
Keeps the popup (interstitial) ad of mini apps and mini games from showing. Reward videos are a separate feature. Takes effect after you reopen the mini app.

Keeps messages you received when others recall them by holding the recall command back before the host applies it, and marks the row with a small \"recall attempted\" line. Your own recalls are unchanged and content already recalled cannot be restored.
Add post details to the share panel: author, publish time, engagement, video and image parameters, and resource links. Search, copy or save the extracted information.
Too much information for the clipboard. Save a text file or tap an individual field to copy it.
Reading or operation failed (%1$s). See the module log.
Tap a field to copy it; long-press to expand or collapse. Times use your phone’s time zone. Data comes from the current post; copy and save include all extracted information.
No details available for this post
There are %1$d more images not expanded.

Adds forwarding to the long-press menu of voice messages: pick up to 20 friends or group chats and a copy of the voice is sent to each. Duration and encrypted resources are kept. A failed or uncertain send stops the run and is never retried.
A voice forward is already in progress.
No friends or group chats to choose from.

Shows your friend groups before the friend list of the share panel. Tapping a group shares the post to all its friends through Douyin\'s own share service. A group is sent only when every friend in it is still in your friend list. Douyin\'s answer says it handled the share, not that every friend received it.
One group per line as name=uid,uid,… Up to 20 groups with distinct names of 1–30 characters, each with 1–100 friends. An invalid line keeps the feature from starting.
Each group holds 1 to 100 friends, at most 20 groups. Tapping a group on the share page shares to every friend in it. Restart Douyin after saving.
Enter a name of 1 to 30 characters that no other group uses, and pick at least one friend.
A group holds at most 100 friends.
The first friend\'s avatar. Tap to pick your own.
Your own picture. Tap to change it.
The picture could not be read or saved.
A group share is already in progress.
Could not share to the group: %1$s

Checks the pets you share with the chosen friends at each interval and gives a free food when yours has run out. Paid food is given only with a food ID set, paid food allowed and a price limit. Every feeding is saved before it is sent, so one whose result is unknown is never sent again for the same period. Needs Douyin running and its pet page opened once since it started.
Leave empty to give a free food.
Only for the food ID above and within the price limit. Off by default.
When off, messages you recall yourself disappear as usual.
How a message kept from a recall is marked in the chat. Only messages kept since Douyin started are marked.
Adds Copy all and Save all, which print every field of the author as JSON with Douyin\'s own Gson. Save writes to Downloads/Nuke.
Clears the backgrounds of the comment list.
#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB; empty keeps Douyin\'s colors. A wrong value makes the install fail.
The comment records could not be read
Your comment is visible to everyone
Your comment is waiting for review
Your comment is visible to mutual followers only
Your comment is probably not visible (status %1$s)
Your comment is not in the public comment list; it may be hidden or deleted
Could not check the comment: no web session, or the request failed
Checks each new comment once after the delay below and shows the result as a toast.
Review usually takes a moment; checking too early may show it as under review.
Java time pattern, for example yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. A wrong pattern makes the install fail.
Adds Bookmark next to Comment details, and Bookmarked comments to the share panel to open them later.
Background set; it shows from the next comment panel
Adds Comment background to the share panel to choose an image (or remove it). The image shows behind the comment list from the next comment panel on.
